# Set approach

**Where are we filmed, and does it change?** · [all approaches](index.md)


## One fixed signature set
<a id="fixed-signature"></a>

The same corner, light and colours in every reel.

**Looks like:** A purple and blue wall wash, a warm lamp, a mic on an arm, the same tee. Recognisable at thumbnail size.

**Good at:** recognition; fast setup; consistency

**Weak at:** visual sameness; fewer pattern interrupts

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches tech, gaming · goals follows, speed · effort low

**How:** Mark the tripod spot and save the light settings.

**Backed by:** [Fixed set and colour identity](../topics/brand.md#brand-fixed-set-identity), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook), [Teaching format: template card, then a real example](../topics/editing.md#l11-template-then-example), [3x3 wall of reels proves a trend](../topics/effects.md#l10-3x3-reel-wall), [Something new on screen every 1.2–2.5 s](../topics/editing.md#edit-change-every-1-5-2-5s) · sources R1

## Rotating sets as pattern interrupts
<a id="rotating-sets"></a>

Several sets (desk, wall, booth) rotated every few minutes in long form.

**Looks like:** Each new chapter starts in a different place: a neon tunnel, a CRT wall, a desk. The scenery itself resets attention.

**Good at:** long-form retention; production value; each chapter feels fresh

**Weak at:** locations to manage; time

**Best for:** formats yt-long, reel90 · niches all · goals retention · effort high

**How:** Shoot the chapters in batches per set.

**Backed by:** [Treat places as sets](../topics/filming.md#film-sets-evergreen-temporary), [Voice cadence as pattern interrupt](../topics/sound.md#sound-voice-cadence-interrupt), [Make motion visible with a dotted trail](../topics/effects.md#fx-trail-visual-proof), [Entrances ease out, exits ease in](../topics/effects.md#fx-ease-out-entrances) · sources L07

## Real places as sets
<a id="real-locations"></a>

Evergreen spots (gym, room, desk) and temporary ones (an event, a trip) used as the backdrop.

**Looks like:** The tip is filmed at the squat rack, the next at the PC desk, the next at a viewpoint. The place is part of the content.

**Good at:** natural variety; B-roll built in; lifestyle feel

**Weak at:** light and sound vary; permission and etiquette in public

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, story, carousel · niches gym, travel, all · goals follows, shares · effort medium

**How:** Gym etiquette and lens rules; lock exposure and focus; 1x lens in low light.

**Backed by:** [Treat places as sets](../topics/filming.md#film-sets-evergreen-temporary), [Gym B-roll every session](../topics/filming.md#film-gym-broll), [Travel shots: silhouettes, backs, slow-mo](../topics/filming.md#film-travel-shots), [Lock AE/AF, grid on, clean lens](../topics/filming.md#film-lock-ae-af), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook) · sources L07, SP

## A backdrop that teaches
<a id="teaching-backdrop"></a>

The background itself carries meaning: printed examples, a board, the products.

**Looks like:** Behind you, a wall of printed favourite ads or a shelf of the parts being discussed. The set does part of the explaining.

**Good at:** authority; context without graphics; memorable look

**Weak at:** prep time; can clutter the frame

**Best for:** formats reel60, yt-long, podcast · niches tech, all · goals trust · effort medium

**How:** Arrange the props once and keep them out of the text safe zones.

**Backed by:** [Podcast set and a backdrop that teaches](../topics/filming.md#film-podcast-set), [Desire hook: this is exactly what you want to see](../topics/hooks.md#l11-desire-hook), [Demo each effect on your own shot](../topics/effects.md#l10-apply-effect-on-yourself), [Untangle: hook, format, topic, illustration](../topics/growth.md#growth-untangle-data), [Hook = title + verbal + visual](../topics/hooks.md#hook-title-verbal-visual) · sources L09, L08

## Mixing
A fixed home set for talking reels plus real locations for B-roll is a common split. Rotating sets is the long-form version of switching layouts.

## Rule of thumb
Recognition and speed: fixed set. Long form: rotating. Lifestyle niches: real locations. Expert authority: a teaching backdrop.
